english.note: Use 都 as the all-purpose casual choice when something happens despite a contrary condition or reluctance.

exampleSentences.english: Even if it rains, I'll go anyway.
exampleSentences.jyutping: zau6 syun3 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 heoi3

english.note: Use 都 after a contrast to say that something happens nevertheless or despite the preceding fact.

exampleSentences.english: Even if it rains, I still go anyway.
exampleSentences.jyutping: zau6 syun3 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 ziu3 heoi3
